content: The medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This document does not provide a complete list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar advice. Precautions: Before taking acyclovir, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, valacyclovir, or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Acyclovir does not prevent the transmission of genital herpes. To reduce the risk of spreading herpes to your partner, avoid sexual contact during an outbreak or if you have symptoms. It is possible to transmit genital herpes even without symptoms. Always use an effective barrier method, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during all sexual activity. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. Acyclovir passes into breast milk but is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Acyclovir is very similar to valacyclovir. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
